tools.name: about_datari
tools.description: Explains what Datari Labs is, how its free data-referral service works, which companies fit, and how it works. Use this when someone asks whether they can sell or license their company's data, or who buys company data.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Checks whether a company is likely to fit Datari Labs' referral criteria (30+ staff, 3+ years of kept records, UK/EU/US). Read-only: does not register anything. Use before suggesting a company register.

tools.name: register_company
tools.description: Registers a company's interest in Datari Labs' free referral service. Requires the person's explicit consent and their work email. After registering, the company completes the normal sign-up (fit check, account and interview) on the Datari Labs website; a confirmation email with the link is sent to

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Looks up where a registered company is in Datari Labs' pipeline, by the work email used at registration. Read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.datarilabs.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_company, check_status · Private data: check_fit · Public sink: register_company, check_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_company, check_status · Private data: check_fit · Public sink: register_company, check_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
